title: AGNI: Autonomous Ground Navigation Intelligence
description: Real-time perception + navigation stack for UGV in unstructured terrain
problem: UGVs operating in unstructured outdoor environments face unreliable terrain, dynamic obstacles, and poor GPS conditions. Existing navigation stacks fail under real-world noise and latency constraints.
approach: Built a modular autonomy stack with LiDAR-based obstacle detection, camera-based semantic understanding, and a hybrid planner combining A* and local reactive control. Designed for low-latency execution on embedded hardware.
outcome: Achieved stable autonomous navigation in outdoor test scenarios with dynamic obstacle avoidance and reduced collision rate by ~40%. System ran fully onboard with real-time performance.
